header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text: فِي الْبُطُونِ ۞ كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ ۞ خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَي سَوَآءِ الْجَحِيمِ ۞ ثُمَّ صُبُّوا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ ۞ ذُقْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ ۞ إِنَّ هذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, the cactus tree is the food of the sinners; (it) will be like molten copper; it will boil in the bellies (of the people of Jahannam) — like the boiling of extremely hot water. “Seize him (the sinner); drag him to the middle of Jahannam, then pour the punishing boiling water over his head” (the keepers of Jahannam will be commanded). Taste (this punishment); indeed you are the mighty, the honoured (as you used to say with arrogant pride, the angels will also say). Indeed th(is punishment) is that which you used to doubt (and deny) (it will also be said).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (مِنْ وَّرَآئِهِ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَي مِنْ مَّآءٍ صَدِيدٍ ۞ يَّتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ وَيَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَّمَاهُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ ؕ وَمِنْ وَّرَائِهِ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Before him is Jahannam; (there) he will be given to drink of festering water. He will gulp it little by little (with difficulty), and it will not go down easily for him; death will come to him from every place (of his body); (yet) he will not die; and after that too there is a severe punishment.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ:قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ﵁: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ!
